title: Bounded-below derived direct image has quasi-coherent cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and let $a\in\mathbf Z$ satisfy $H^j(E)=0$ for all $j<a$ [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Then $H^q(Rf_*E)$ is quasi-coherent for every $q\in\mathbf Z$, equivalently $Rf_*E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$, where $Rf_*$ is [def-pc-derived-direct-image].

proof.text: Choose a strictly bounded-below representative K of E using DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE from [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Package K as CochainComplex.Plus and obtain homology vanishing below a from exactAt_of_isGE. Apply exists_truncationHypercohomology [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage. Its unbounded right derived functor is definitionally schemeDerivedDirectImage [def-pc-derived-direct-image], so no additional resolution comparison is needed. The E2 comparison identifies the nonnegative-first-index terms with the ordinary higher direct images of H^j(K), which is quasi-coherent by the homology isomorphism from E to Q(K).

Use clause (1) of [lem-pc-finite-support-hi], specifically the existing declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_higherDirectImage in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Cohomology.DirectImage.Sections, to make every nonnegative-first-index E2 term quasi-coherent. The two module pushforward functors and their ordinary right derived functors are definitionally compatible. Negative first-index terms are zero by [thm-sp-truncation-e2] and hence quasi-coherent: the free sheaf on the empty set supplies the zero object for this object property. No compactness of the target or uniform higher-direct-image vanishing bound is used.

Prove quasi-coherence of every term of pageCouple r by natural-number induction. The successor E-term is by definition the cokernel of the incoming differential lifted to the kernel of the outgoing differential. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-kernel] to the latter kernel and the cokernel clause of [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image] to the lifted map. The shared SheafOfModules and Scheme.Modules category structures are definitionally compatible for these applications, so no separate transfer theorem is needed. Since page r is pageCouple (r-2), all finite pages are quasi-coherent.

For each integer n, use the abutment filtration FH n of [thm-sp-truncation-e2]. It is full at index 0 and zero at N = max(0,n-a+1), an integer represented by its natural-number toNat. For p<0 its graded piece is zero. For p>=0 the supplied isomorphisms grc.symm followed by psi identify the graded piece directly with a finite page term; step 3 makes it quasi-coherent. In a general abelian category, an isomorphism-invariant extension-closed object property containing zero passes from these graded pieces to the whole filtered object: induct on k to prove the property for step(N-k), starting at the zero step, using the short exact cokernel sequence for step(i+1) into step(i), and finish at k=N using the top subobject isomorphism. Instantiate extension closure with [lem-pc-quasi-coherent-extension]. Finally transport from H n to H^n(Rf_*QK), using the theorem's hH equality, and along Rf_* of E isomorphic to QK. This proves the assertion for all n, including n<a.

theorem schemeDerivedDirectImage_preserves_QCoh_of_isGE
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X E)
    (a : ℤ) [E.IsGE a] :
    schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E)
